description: This source file defines the MessageAnnotationsInjectAdapter class, which implements the TextMap interface for injecting properties into AMQP 1.0 message annotations within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: MessageAnnotationsInjectAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class that implements the TextMap interface, allowing injection of key-value pairs into AMQP message annotations for tracing purposes.

methods.name: MessageAnnotationsInjectAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that creates an adapter instance for a specific message and annotation map name.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException; enumeration of entries is not supported.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the message's properties map annotation.

methods.name: getPropertiesMap
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the properties map annotation in the message.
